snippet.title: THE ORDER OF THE DAMNED | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
THE ORDER OF THE DAMNED is a story-driven, 2D action-rpg with old-school DNA, set in a Grimdark Arthurian world. As one of the last remnants of a fallen order of knights, choose your path as you battle through the decaying land in a brutal quest to uncover the mystery of the Spectre that haunts you and destroy the ancient darkness of The Revenant.

Wishlist now on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4683050/The_Order_Of_The_Damned/
